korvo_ble_init.message0: initialize Korvo agent Bluetooth name %1 screen %2 camera %3 serial debug %4 App firmware update %5
korvo_ble_init.tooltip: Initialize ESP32-S3-Korvo-2 V3: speaker, microphones, camera, screen and Bluetooth; then connect with the Agent Link App using this Bluetooth name. Needs 16MB flash and OPI PSRAM. Serial debug prints startup and link messages at 115200. With App firmware update on, the App can write new firmware over Bluetooth, replacing this program; needs a partition scheme with two app slots (the default app3M_fat9M_16MB works)

korvo_ble_is_ready.tooltip: True once the App is connected and subscribed; only then voice, photos and text can be sent

korvo_ble_print_status.tooltip: Print link, channel, playback and memory status to serial (turn on serial debug in initialize)

korvo_ble_talk_start.message0: Korvo start %1 for up to %2 seconds
korvo_ble_talk_start.tooltip: Start uploading microphone audio; it stops by itself after the time. Voice command: the agent replies when you finish. Live transcription: the App turns speech into text as you speak (the App must open its audio channel). Both need the App connected

korvo_ble_talk_stop.tooltip: End the voice upload; the agent then replies

korvo_ble_is_talking.tooltip: True while voice is being uploaded

korvo_ble_is_speaking.tooltip: True while the agent voice reply is being received or played

korvo_ble_test_tone.tooltip: Play a 1 kHz test tone for one second locally to check the speaker, no Bluetooth involved

korvo_ble_send_prompt.tooltip: Send a piece of text to the agent as a prompt, for example "take a photo and check whether anyone is there"

korvo_ble_take_photo.tooltip: Take a 240×240 photo, encode it as JPEG and upload it to the App; ignored while the previous one is still uploading

korvo_ble_on_text.tooltip: Runs when the agent sends text; get it with "text from agent". Do not wait long inside

korvo_ble_agent_text.tooltip: The latest text received from the agent (UTF-8)

korvo_ble_show_text.tooltip: Show text on the screen: letters, digits and common symbols; Chinese shows as ?. Agent text is shown automatically too

korvo_ble_backlight.tooltip: Turn the screen backlight on or off

korvo_ble_update_sensor.message0: Korvo report sensor ID %1 name %2 unit %3 type %4 value %5
korvo_ble_update_sensor.tooltip: Report a reading to the agent. Use a unique ID of letters and digits; offline only the latest value is kept and sent after reconnecting

korvo_ble_on_control.message0: when App controls ID %1 name %2 type %3
korvo_ble_on_control.tooltip: Registers a controllable endpoint in the App and agent and runs when a command arrives; get the value with "App sent". Do not wait long inside

korvo_ble_control_value.tooltip: Value of the latest App control command: number, switch (true/false) or text

korvo_ble_camera_preview.tooltip: Show the camera picture live on the screen (about 15 fps); screen text pauses during the preview and comes back when it is turned off

korvo_ble_touch_pressed.tooltip: True while a finger is on the touch screen

korvo_ble_touch_point.tooltip: Position of the latest touch in landscape coordinates: X 0–279 (left to right), Y 0–239 (top to bottom)

korvo_ble_sd_ready.tooltip: True when a FAT32 TF card is inserted and recordings can be written; the card is mounted at initialize, restart after changing it

korvo_ble_record_start.message0: Korvo start recording to TF card
korvo_ble_record_start.tooltip: Record the microphone to files such as rec-0001.wav in the records folder of the TF card (IMA-ADPCM, about 8 KB/s); works together with voice upload, and the App can browse the recordings

korvo_ble_record_stop.tooltip: Finish recording and save the file; a file not stopped properly (for example on power loss) may not open

korvo_ble_record_seconds.tooltip: Seconds recorded so far; keeps the last length after stopping

korvo_ble_record_file.tooltip: File name of the latest recording, for example rec-0001.wav; empty before the first recording
